_comment: Defaults for Export-AzResourceGroupIaC.ps1. Any script parameter you pass on the command line overrides the matching value here. Copy this file and pass -ConfigPath to keep per-environment variants.

resourceFilters._comment: includeTypes/excludeTypes use wildcard matching against the full resource type, e.g. 'Microsoft.Storage/*'. Name patterns are regular expressions.
resourceFilters._excludeChildTypesComment: Child resources removed from the EXPORTED TEMPLATES (they are not top-level inventory items, so the type filters above never see them). These are provisioned automatically by Azure and cannot be meaningfully redeployed: a single Log Analytics workspace exports ~1350 built-in table schemas, which alone pushes a template past Bicep's 800-resource limit. Every removal is counted in reports/portability-report.md - clear this list if you need a byte-faithful export.

secrets._comment: policy: RedactAndParameterize (secure param reference) or Placeholder (__REDACTED__ literal). failOnResidualSecret aborts the run before any artefact is written if the final text scan still finds secret-shaped values.
secrets._allowKeyPatternsComment: Property names that must NEVER be redacted. The first group NAME a secret rather than containing one - redacting them breaks the reference (secretRef is how Container Apps point an env var at a declared secret). The rest are usernames, public keys and type discriminators.

portability._comment: Transforms applied so the template deploys into a different RG/subscription/tenant. locationStrategy: parameter (add a 'location' param defaulted to the source region) or literal (leave regions hardcoded).
portability._stripReadOnlyChildIdsComment: Inline child objects (those with their own 'name') come back carrying the 'id' Azure assigned them. That is read-only, and where it points at the enclosing resource the decompiled Bicep self-references and fails to compile (BCP079). Only stripped when the value is resource-id-shaped, so reference objects such as subnet:{id:...} - which have no sibling 'name' - are untouched.
portability._readOnlyNote: Deliberately NOT stripped: generic names like 'state', 'status' and 'hostName' are read-only on some resource types but genuinely deployable on others, so removing them breaks more than it fixes. Add them per-environment only if you know your resource mix.
portability._redundantInlineChildrenComment: Azure exports subnets BOTH inline on the virtual network AND as standalone child resources. Decompiling that produces Bicep with a dependency cycle (BCP079/BCP080). The standalone duplicates are dropped and anything that depended on them is re-pointed at the parent, which is correct: inline children are created with it.
portability._requireValueTypesComment: Types whose secret value Azure never exports. The resource would deploy empty or fail, so it is reported as a blocking item. With parameterizeMissingSecretValues each one's value is also wired to a new secure parameter, which deploy/Deploy-Target.ps1 prompts for - the value never has to be written to disk.

supplemental._comment: Collected for audit and drift detection only. Not emitted as IaC: principal object ids are tenant-scoped and would fail to deploy elsewhere.

permissions._comment: Produces reports/resources-and-permissions.md: every resource type reverse-engineered, and the control-plane actions needed to read them here and create them elsewhere. Actions are read from Azure's provider operation catalogue at runtime rather than hard-coded. suggestBuiltInRoles adds one catalogue-wide Get-AzRoleDefinition call to rank built-in roles by least privilege.

validation._comment: bicepBuild recompiles the generated Bicep to confirm the ARM -> Bicep round trip is still valid.
